why_trace.root_cause: PsqlRunner let subprocess.TimeoutExpired propagate; its message repeats the argv including -d <dsn>, so a database password reached the ledger's resolve event when psql timed out.
evidence: tests/test_resolve.py RedactionRound3Test.test_psql_timeout_does_not_carry_the_dsn uses a fake psql that sleeps past the timeout and asserts the password is absent from the error
